events.text: Pushing the branch and opening the pull request.

args.body:
* Added support for priority levels (low, medium, high) to todos
* Modified `addTodo` to accept an optional priority in the options object (defaults to medium)
* Updated `listTodos` to order results by priority first, then by creation time within the same priority
* Added tests to verify ordering by priority and rejection of invalid priority values
* All tests pass
